data.key: Sorcerer Bonus Spell L4 ~ Minor Creation
data.name: Minor Creation
data.description: You create a nonmagical, unattended object of nonliving vegetable matter. The volume of the item created cannot exceed 1 cubic foot per caster level. You must succeed on an appropriate Craft skill check to make a complex item. Attempting to use any created object as a material component causes the spell to fail.|PRERULE:1,DisplayFullSpell
